mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rooms ( accommodation_id, name, description, capacity, price_per_night, room_type, bed_type, bathroom_count, amenities, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{accommodationId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{capacity}, #{pricePerNight}, #{roomType}, #{bedType}, #{bathroomCount}, #{amenities}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM rooms r WHERE r.accommodation_id = #{accommodationId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.room_id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ra.room_id FROM room_availability ra WHERE ra.room_id = r.room_id AND ra.date BETWEEN #{checkInDate} AND DATE_SUB(#{checkOutDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND ra.available_count <= 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE rooms SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, capacity = #{capacity}, price_per_night = #{pricePerNight}, room_type = #{roomType}, bed_type = #{bedType}, bathroom_count = #{bathroomCount}, amenities = #{amenities}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
